t: You are looking at the statue of Sir Arthur Harris, one of three statues outside the front of St Clement Danes church on the Strand. It is one of two here by the sculptor Faith Winter, the other being Hugh Dowding. Harris was Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of RAF Bomber Command during the height of the Anglo-American strategic bombing campaign against Nazi Germany in the Second World War. The press called him Bomber Harris, while within the RAF he was often known as Butcher. Winter was a British sculptor known for statues and memorials to military and historical figures.
